eager.zh: 渴望的、急切的（be eager to）

ex.en: She is eager to live in Australia.
ex.zh: 她渴望住在澳洲。

ex.en: He is eager to go there.
ex.zh: 他很想去那裡。

ex.en: He is eager to please.
ex.zh: 他非常想討人喜歡。

eager.en: wanting very much to do or have something

ex.en: Each member has to pay 10,000 yen a month.
ex.zh: 每位會員每個月要繳一萬日圓。

ex.en: Each time he escaped, he returned to this region.
ex.zh: 他每次逃走，都會回到這個地區。

each.en: every one of two or more things, thought of separately

ex.en: The principal presented each of the graduates with diploma.
ex.zh: 校長頒發畢業證書給每位畢業生。

ex.en: Each of us has a different job.
ex.zh: 我們每個人的工作都不一樣。

each.en: every one of a group, thought of separately

ex.en: After all they came to terms with each other.
ex.zh: 最後他們彼此達成了協議。

ex.en: You must not talk to each other in class.
ex.zh: 上課時不可以互相講話。

each.en: used to show that two people do the same thing to one another

ex.en: You don't get up as early as your sister.
ex.zh: 你沒有你姐姐那麼早起。

ex.en: I went to bed early, for I was tired.
ex.zh: 我很早就上床睡覺了，因為很累。

ex.en: Had I arrived earlier, I could have seen Kelly.
ex.zh: 如果我早點到，就能見到凱莉了。

early.en: before the usual or expected time

ex.en: I have an early meeting tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天一早有個會。

ex.en: The building was built in the early 1900s.
ex.zh: 這棟建築建於1900年代初期。

early.en: near the beginning of a time, or before the usual time

ex.en: The math homework was easier than I had expected.
ex.zh: 那份數學功課比我想的簡單。

ex.en: It is easy for me to read this book.
ex.zh: 這本書對我來說很容易讀。

ex.en: I find this problem easier than I originally thought.
ex.zh: 我發現這個問題比我原本想的簡單。

easy.en: not difficult to do or understand

easy.zh: take it easy：放輕鬆、別緊張

ex.en: Take it easy, there's no rush.
ex.zh: 放輕鬆，不用急。

ex.en: The doctor told me to take it easy.
ex.zh: 醫生叫我好好休息。

easy.en: to relax and not worry or work too hard

ex.en: You will soon get used to eating Japanese food.
ex.zh: 你很快就會習慣吃日本料理。

ex.en: I ate lunch two and a half hours ago.
ex.zh: 我兩個半小時前吃了午餐。

ex.en: I like grapes, but I can't eat so many.
ex.zh: 我雖然喜歡葡萄，但吃不了那麼多。

eat.en: to put food in your mouth and swallow it

ex.en: We usually eat out on Friday nights.
ex.zh: 我們週五晚上通常在外面吃。

ex.en: Eating out every day is expensive.
ex.zh: 每天外食很花錢。

eat.en: to have a meal in a restaurant instead of at home

ex.en: He wasn't earning a large salary when he retired.
ex.zh: 他退休時薪水並不高。

ex.en: He earns not more than 50 dollars a week.
ex.zh: 他一個星期賺不到五十美元。

ex.en: The more you earn, the more you spend.
ex.zh: 賺得越多，花得越多。

earn.en: to get money for work that you do

ex.en: She earned the respect of her team.
ex.zh: 她贏得了團隊的尊敬。

ex.en: You've earned a good rest.
ex.zh: 你應該好好休息一下了。

earn.en: to get something good because of what you have done

ex.en: You'll be able to see the difference very easily.
ex.zh: 你很容易就能看出差別。

ex.en: You should be able to read this book easily.
ex.zh: 你應該能輕鬆讀懂這本書。

ex.en: You won't be able to fool Tom so easily.
ex.zh: 你沒辦法那麼輕易騙過湯姆。

ex.en: About one third of the earth's surface is land.
ex.zh: 地球表面約有三分之一是陸地。

ex.en: Today our artificial satellites are revolving around the earth.
ex.zh: 如今我們的人造衛星正繞著地球運轉。

ex.en: The earth is similar to an orange in shape.
ex.zh: 地球的形狀像柳橙。

earth.en: the planet that we live on

ex.en: What on earth are you doing in my room?
ex.zh: 你到底在我房間裡做什麼？

ex.en: Why on earth did you sell your newly-built house?
ex.zh: 你到底為什麼把新蓋好的房子賣掉？

earth.en: used in questions to show surprise or anger

ex.en: A rabbit has long ears and a short tail.
ex.zh: 兔子有長耳朵和短尾巴。

ex.en: He listened with his ear to the door.
ex.zh: 他把耳朵貼在門上聽。

ear.en: the part of the body on the side of the head that you hear with

ear.zh: 聽力、辨音能力（have an ear for）

ex.en: She has a good ear for music.
ex.zh: 她很有音感。

ex.en: He has an ear for languages.
ex.zh: 他學語言很有天分。

ear.en: the ability to notice and enjoy sounds, especially music

ear.zh: play it by ear：見機行事、隨機應變

ex.en: You'll have to play it by ear at the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時你得見機行事。

ex.en: We don't have a plan yet, so let's play it by ear.
ex.zh: 我們還沒有計畫，就見機行事吧。

ear.en: to decide what to do as things happen, without a plan

ex.en: The sun always rises in the east.
ex.zh: 太陽總是從東方升起。

ex.en: The wind is blowing from the east.
ex.zh: 風從東邊吹來。

ex.en: Nagoya is to the east of Kyoto.
ex.zh: 名古屋在京都的東邊。

east.en: the direction where the sun comes up

ex.en: The east coast of Taiwan is beautiful.
ex.zh: 台灣的東海岸很美。

ex.en: Our office is on the east side of the city.
ex.zh: 我們的辦公室在城市的東區。

east.en: in or toward the part of a place where the sun comes up

ex.en: We drove east for two hours.
ex.zh: 我們往東開了兩個小時。

ex.en: The window faces east.
ex.zh: 這扇窗戶朝東。

east.en: toward the direction where the sun comes up

ease.zh: 容易、輕鬆（with ease：輕而易舉）

ex.en: She passed the exam with ease.
ex.zh: 她輕輕鬆鬆就通過了考試。

ex.en: The app is popular for its ease of use.
ex.zh: 這個 App 因為容易使用而大受歡迎。

ease.en: the quality of being easy to do, without trouble

ease.zh: at ease：自在、放鬆（ill at ease：不自在）

ex.en: I am very ill at ease with strangers.
ex.zh: 我和陌生人相處時很不自在。

ex.en: When I speak Chinese, I start to feel at ease.
ex.zh: 我說中文時開始覺得自在了。

ex.en: Money won't make you merry, but it eases your misery.
ex.zh: 錢不能讓你快樂，但可以減輕你的痛苦。

ex.en: This medicine will ease the pain.
ex.zh: 這種藥可以減輕疼痛。

ease.en: to make a problem or pain less bad

ex.en: Alcohol consumption is higher in Eastern Europe than in Western Europe.
ex.zh: 東歐的飲酒量比西歐高。

ex.en: The eastern part of the island is very quiet.
ex.zh: 這座島的東部非常安靜。

ex.en: She is interested in Eastern philosophy.
ex.zh: 她對東方哲學很有興趣。

eastern.en: in or from the east of a place

ex.en: When the big earthquake occurred, I was just ten.
ex.zh: 大地震發生的時候，我才十歲。

ex.en: They had their houses destroyed by a strong earthquake.
ex.zh: 他們的房子被強烈地震震毀了。

ex.en: The recent frequency of earthquakes makes us nervous.
ex.zh: 最近地震頻繁，讓我們很緊張。

earthquake.en: a sudden strong shaking of the ground

ex.en: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.
ex.zh: 企業第一季的盈餘大幅成長。

ex.en: The company expects higher earnings next quarter.
ex.zh: 公司預期下季盈餘會增加。

earnings.en: the money that a person or company gets from work or business

ex.en: A family-run eatery opened across from the station.
ex.zh: 車站對面新開了一家家庭經營的小餐館。

ex.en: The guide recommends a casual eatery near the market.
ex.zh: 旅遊指南推薦市場附近的一家簡餐店。

eatery.en: a small place where you can buy and eat a meal

ex.en: We took an earlier train to avoid the crowd.
ex.zh: 我們搭了較早的一班火車以避開人潮。

ex.en: In earlier times, people wrote letters by hand.
ex.zh: 在早期，人們用手寫信。

ex.en: As I said earlier, the shop opens at nine.
ex.zh: 如我先前所說，這家店九點開門。

ex.en: You should have told me earlier.
ex.zh: 你應該早點告訴我的。

ex.en: The earl lived in a large castle in the countryside.
ex.zh: 伯爵住在鄉間的一座大城堡裡。

ex.en: In the novel, the earl falls in love with a farmer's daughter.
ex.zh: 小說裡，伯爵愛上了農夫的女兒。

ex.en: An eagle flew high above the mountain.
ex.zh: 一隻老鷹在山的上空高高飛翔。

ex.en: The eagle caught a fish from the river.
ex.zh: 老鷹從河裡抓起一條魚。

ex.en: Eating slowly helps you enjoy your food more.
ex.zh: 吃慢一點能讓你更享受食物。

ex.en: Late-night eating is bad for your health.
ex.zh: 吃宵夜對健康不好。

ex.en: We bought new eating utensils for the picnic.
ex.zh: 我們為野餐買了新的餐具。

ex.en: There are good eating places near the station.
ex.zh: 車站附近有不錯的吃飯地點。

ex.en: Using a map made the trip much easier.
ex.zh: 使用地圖讓這趟旅程輕鬆多了。

ex.en: This problem is easier than the one we solved yesterday.
ex.zh: 這個問題比我們昨天解的那題簡單。

ex.en: It's easier to learn a language when you practice every day.
ex.zh: 每天練習的話，學語言會比較容易。

ex.en: Many families paint eggs together at Easter.
ex.zh: 許多家庭在復活節時會一起彩繪蛋。

ex.en: Easter falls in spring, in March or April.
ex.zh: 復活節落在春天，三月或四月。

ex.en: She lost one earring while dancing at the party.
ex.zh: 她在派對上跳舞時弄丟了一隻耳環。

ex.en: He gave his mother a pair of silver earrings for her birthday.
ex.zh: 他送給媽媽一副銀耳環當生日禮物。

ex.en: He made an earnest effort to learn the new language.
ex.zh: 他認真努力地學習這門新語言。

ex.en: The young man gave an earnest apology for being late.
ex.zh: 這位年輕人誠懇地為遲到道歉。

ex.en: After the long break, the team began training in earnest.
ex.zh: 長時間的休息後，球隊開始認真訓練。

ex.en: It started as a joke, but soon we were talking in earnest.
ex.zh: 一開始只是玩笑，但很快我們就認真談了起來。

ex.en: The kids waited eagerly for the school bus to the zoo.
ex.zh: 孩子們熱切地等著去動物園的校車。

ex.en: She eagerly opened the package from her friend.
ex.zh: 她迫不及待地拆開朋友寄來的包裹。

ex.en: He is the main earner in the family.
ex.zh: 他是家裡主要的經濟來源。

ex.en: Two earners in the household make saving easier.
ex.zh: 家裡有兩個人賺錢，存錢會比較容易。

ex.en: The city earmarked funds for a new library.
ex.zh: 市政府撥出經費專門用於興建新圖書館。

ex.en: She earmarked part of her salary for travel.
ex.zh: 她把薪水的一部分預留作旅行基金。

ex.en: He gave up all his earthly possessions and became a monk.
ex.zh: 他放棄了所有世俗財物，成為僧侶。

ex.en: Some people believe earthly life is only temporary.
ex.zh: 有些人相信人世間的生活只是暫時的。

ex.en: There is no earthly reason to be so upset.
ex.zh: 根本沒有理由這麼難過。

ex.en: I have no earthly idea where he went.
ex.zh: 我完全不知道他去哪了。

ex.en: The painter set up her easel by the river.
ex.zh: 畫家在河邊架起她的畫架。

ex.en: A half-finished picture stood on the easel.
ex.zh: 一幅未完成的畫立在畫架上。

earned.zh: 賺得；掙得（earn 的過去式）

ex.en: She earned enough money last summer to buy a laptop.
ex.zh: 她去年夏天賺的錢足夠買一台筆電。

ex.en: He earned a good salary as an engineer.
ex.zh: 他當工程師賺了不錯的薪水。

ex.en: The doctor earned the trust of all her patients.
ex.zh: 這位醫生贏得了所有病人的信任。

ex.en: The team earned a reputation for honest work.
ex.zh: 這個團隊贏得了誠實做事的名聲。

ex.en: My little brother is a picky eater.
ex.zh: 我弟弟是個挑食的人。

ex.en: She is a big eater and always asks for seconds.
ex.zh: 她食量很大，總是要再添一份。

ex.en: She earnestly asked her boss for another chance.
ex.zh: 她誠懇地請求老闆再給她一次機會。

ex.en: The students worked earnestly on their science project.
ex.zh: 學生們認真地做著科學專題。

ex.en: He earnestly believes that hard work pays off.
ex.zh: 他真心相信努力終有回報。

ex.en: The wine has an earthy smell, like wet soil after rain.
ex.zh: 這支酒有種像雨後濕土的泥土氣味。

ex.en: Mushrooms give the soup a rich, earthy flavor.
ex.zh: 蘑菇讓這道湯有濃郁的土壤風味。

earthy.zh: 直率粗獷的；不拘小節的

ex.en: He has an earthy sense of humor that makes everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 他有種直率不拘的幽默感，讓大家都笑了。

ex.en: Her earthy honesty was refreshing.
ex.zh: 她那種直來直往的坦率令人耳目一新。

ex.en: The students showed great eagerness to learn.
ex.zh: 學生們展現出強烈的求知渴望。

ex.en: He waited for the results with eagerness.
ex.zh: 他熱切地等待結果。

ex.en: The river flows eastward toward the sea.
ex.zh: 這條河向東流向大海。

ex.en: We traveled eastward for three days.
ex.zh: 我們向東旅行了三天。

ex.en: They began their eastward journey at dawn.
ex.zh: 他們在黎明時展開東行的旅程。

ex.en: An eastward wind brought cooler air.
ex.zh: 一陣向東吹的風帶來較涼的空氣。

ex.en: My boss is easygoing and rarely gets angry.
ex.zh: 我的老闆很隨和，很少生氣。

ex.en: She has an easygoing way of dealing with problems.
ex.zh: 她處理問題的方式很輕鬆隨性。

ex.en: The earliest train leaves at five in the morning.
ex.zh: 最早的一班火車清晨五點發車。

ex.en: Please tell me the earliest date you can start work.
ex.zh: 請告訴我你最早可以哪天開始上班。

ex.en: It is rude to eavesdrop on other people's private conversations.
ex.zh: 偷聽別人的私人談話很失禮。

ex.en: She tried to eavesdrop on her parents through the thin wall.
ex.zh: 她試著隔著薄牆偷聽爸媽說話。

ex.en: The river flows eastwards towards the sea.
ex.zh: 這條河向東流向大海。

ex.en: We drove eastwards until we reached the coast.
ex.zh: 我們一路往東開，直到抵達海岸。

ex.en: Birds built a nest under the eave of the barn.
ex.zh: 鳥兒在穀倉的屋簷下築了一個巢。

ex.en: Rain dripped steadily from the eaves of the cottage.
ex.zh: 雨水不斷從小屋的屋簷滴下來。

ex.en: Several earls were invited to the king's feast.
ex.zh: 好幾位伯爵受邀參加國王的宴會。

ex.en: In old England, powerful earls often owned huge areas of land.
ex.zh: 在古老的英格蘭，有權勢的伯爵常擁有大片土地。

ex.en: Please lower your voice; the boss is within earshot.
ex.zh: 請小聲一點，老闆就在聽得到的範圍內。

ex.en: The children played out of earshot of their parents.
ex.zh: 孩子們在父母聽不到的地方玩耍。

ex.en: The earthwork for the new road took two months.
ex.zh: 新道路的土方工程花了兩個月。

ex.en: Workers finished the earthwork before the rain came.
ex.zh: 工人在下雨前完成了土方工程。

ex.en: After the rain, an earthworm crawled across the sidewalk.
ex.zh: 下雨之後，一條蚯蚓爬過人行道。

ex.en: An earthworm helps the soil by loosening it as it moves.
ex.zh: 蚯蚓在移動時會鬆土，對土壤有益。

ex.en: They stored water in a large earthen jar.
ex.zh: 他們把水存放在一個大陶罐裡。

ex.en: The village houses have earthen floors.
ex.zh: 村子裡的房子是泥土地面。

ex.en: She cooked the soup in an earthen pot.
ex.zh: 她用陶鍋煮湯。

ex.en: I lost one earphone on the train.
ex.zh: 我在火車上弄丟了一邊的耳機。

ex.en: She wore an earphone while she jogged.
ex.zh: 她慢跑時戴著一隻耳機。

ex.en: The shop sells hand-painted earthenware bowls.
ex.zh: 這家店賣手繪的陶碗。

ex.en: Ancient earthenware was found at the dig site.
ex.zh: 考古現場出土了古代的陶器。

ex.en: Earthbound astronomers rely on telescopes to see the stars.
ex.zh: 待在地面上的天文學家得靠望遠鏡觀星。

ex.en: After the storm, all earthbound flights were cancelled.
ex.zh: 暴風雨之後，所有班機都停飛了。
